Use your own Assetto Corsa installation

openASC includes no cars, tracks, textures, or sounds. The content tools read files from your local copy of Assetto Corsa (2014).

i

A project at the beginning

Inventory, INI/LUT readers, static KN5 geometry loading, and a local scene viewer are available. Supported diffuse textures and approximate transparency are available. Original shaders and driving are still ahead. Finding a file does not establish compatibility.

What is openASC?

openASC is an open-source effort to build an independent engine for Assetto Corsa content. Inspired by the approach of openOMSI, development starts with understanding file formats and validating one small scene before moving toward a first drive.

The current tools read local configurations and supported static KN5 geometry. An interactive local viewer provides camera controls and mesh inspection without changing the installation. There is no playable simulator yet, and full mod compatibility is a long-term research goal.
